ev.q: Overlord is set in a fantasy world
The player's choices will influence your corruption level, either raising or lowering it
simultaneously controlling the Overlord and an army of goblin-like minions
new rooms and spells become available for use
The satire is funny, and the evil is deliciously over-the-top
Armour and weapons can be purchased or improved in the forge
the controls not being able to keep up with the game's pace
